question: Does the deployed second bounded duplicate-context correction allow a fresh Ukrainian neutron-star request to pass topic and photo inspection, natural-speed narration and final QA?
stop_conditions: Submit this ID once; never retry it.
Preserve ambiguous provider outcomes as terminal/unknown.
Stop at first factuality, source, relevance, quota, duration, alignment, render or machine-audit failure.
Keep natural-speed voice, relevant real photographs, exact duration and QA gates unchanged.
Stop media generation if /data free space falls below 100 MB.
This plan authorizes one request only.

result.terminal_error: MaterialUnavailable: not enough inspected distinct photographs for requested cadence
result.diagnosis: Photo search returned generic star fields, unrelated astronomical objects, diagrams and artist concepts. Independent pixel inspection accepted one Hubble image of RX J185635-3754. The request stopped before narration/TTS/render as designed; do not retry this ID.

inspection_breakdown.interpretation: 29/30 were rejected by the existing visual gate. The failure is a real search/availability shortfall, not a voice or render defect.

result.replay_status: Source/search/model/inspection receipts and 21 MB photo catalog exist on production; a complete read-only replay has not yet been performed.

confirmed_search_queries.impact: Wikimedia returned shuttle/person/storm/deep-field results; Pixabay/Pexels returned generic cosmic/stock results.
Returned diagrams, simulations, artist concepts and generic star/galaxy images alongside the one valid Hubble observation.
Equipment-name search returned unrelated moon, nebula and galaxy imagery.

result.root_cause: The reviewed brief allowed generic “space” and equipment-only “Hubble Space Telescope” as photo search hints. Their broad provider results consumed the bounded candidate/download budget. No deterministic pre-search contract rejects these weak hints; strict pixel-level photo review then correctly stopped the request.
result.next_offline_action: Design and test a generic source-grounded observable-entity query contract using saved multi-topic fixtures; retain exact image relevance, uniqueness and cadence gates.
